meta.description: Symptom → cause knowledge base powering the AI Assistant / visual diagnosis. Each cause links to a system, an exploded-diagram plate and (where available) a purchasable part, so the assistant can 'Show on Diagram' and 'View Part'.
meta.disclaimer: Probabilities are indicative guidance, not a workshop diagnosis. Always confirm with a qualified mechanic.

greeting: Hi! Describe the symptom and I'll point you to the likely cause, show it on the exploded diagram, and link the genuine part.

problems.label: Hard to start in the morning
problems.query: My bike is hard to start in the morning
problems.intro: That's usually one of these. Tap a part to inspect it or show it on the diagram:
steps: Inspect, clean or replace the spark plug
Clean or replace the air filter
Confirm fuel is flowing from the tap

problems.label: Clicking noise when starting
problems.query: There's a clicking noise when I press the starter
problems.intro: A click on start-up usually points to the starter drive. Most common causes:
steps: Listen: single click vs rapid clicks

problems.label: Noise when braking
problems.query: The brakes make a squealing / clicking noise
problems.intro: Brake noise on the Boxer is almost always the rear drum assembly. Likely causes:
steps: Confirm axle and spokes are tight

problems.label: Losing power / poor pickup
problems.query: The bike is losing power and pickup is poor
problems.intro: Power loss usually comes from the clutch or fuelling. Start here:
steps: Clean the carburetor and set idle
Replace worn friction plates if slipping
